fact: On 6 November 2024 Telecom Egypt announced the first landing in Egypt, at Ras Ghareb, of the Africa-1 subsea cable being built by a consortium that includes Algérie Télécom and Telecom Egypt, with a second Egyptian landing planned and Sudan and Algeria among the linked countries.
title: المصرية للاتصالات تعلن نجاح إنزال نظام الكابل البحري "Africa-1" في مصر
